messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- Boreal owns the indexer as of 2026-04-22, after Team Dune handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-22 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-22-search-indexer]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the indexer as of 2025-11-18, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-15 to 2026-04-22; recorded by handover/2025-12-15-search-indexer-correction]
    earlier: Ember owns the indexer as of 2025-11-18, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-11-18 to 2025-12-15; recorded by handover/2025-11-18-search-indexer]
    earlier: Boreal still owns the indexer as of 2025-09-15. [valid 2025-09-15 to 2025-11-18; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-15-2]
- The indexer belongs to the Boreal team as of 2025-02-28. [decision; valid 2025-02-28 to now; recorded by handover/2025-02-28-search-indexer]
    earlier: Cinder owns the indexer as of 2025-01-17. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-02-28; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- The indexer must stay on OpenSearch 2.11 until the full reindex completes. [constraint; valid 2025-08-13 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-08-13]
- The indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change, as noticed by Cinder on 2025-08-29. [valid 2025-08-29 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-29-2]
- The indexer moved from Boreal to Team Dune as of 2025-11-18. [decision; valid 2025-12-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-15-search-indexer-correction]
    earlier: The indexer moved from Boreal to Ember as of 2025-11-18. [decision; valid 2025-11-18 to 2025-12-15; recorded by handover/2025-11-18-search-indexer]
- On 2026-03-16, Ember noticed that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2026-03-16 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2026-03-16]
- The indexer moved from Team Dune to Boreal as of 2026-04-22. [decision; valid 2026-04-22 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-22-search-indexer]
- The indexer depends on the product catalog for product documents. [valid 2025-03-03 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-03-03]
- INC-2025-023 was an incident involving the indexer on 2025-10-24. [valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The indexer's incremental updates left stale entries behind after failed writes. [valid 2025-11-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-07]
- Cinder owns the notifier as of 2025-11-19; Boreal owned it until that date. [decision; valid 2025-11-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-19-notifier]
    earlier: Boreal owns notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-11-19; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- The indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write, as agreed on 2025-11-07. [decision; valid 2025-11-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-07]
- Team Atlas observed on 2025-11-11 that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy. [valid 2025-11-11 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-11-11]
- Team Dune owns image-resizer as of 2026-01-20, after Boreal handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-01-20 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-20-image-resizer]
    earlier: Boreal owns image-resizer as of 2025-11-19, after Cinder handed it over. [decision; valid 2025-11-19 to 2026-01-20; recorded by handover/2025-11-19-image-resizer]
    earlier: Cinder owns image-resizer as of 2025-06-25. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to 2025-11-19; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-image-resizer]
    earlier: Team Dune owns image-resizer. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- Marcus Oyelaran walked Oskar through the indexer runbook on 2025-11-18. [valid 2025-11-18 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-18-search-indexer]
- A silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023. [valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- The reports pipeline went to Boreal as of 2025-06-25, not Ember; Team Ember never owned it, and Team Dune no longer owns it. [decision; valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by handover/2025-07-03-reporting-correction]
    earlier: Team Ember owns the reports pipeline as of 2025-06-25, and Team Dune no longer owns it. [decision; valid 2025-06-25 to 2025-07-03; recorded by handover/2025-06-25-reporting]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the reporting service. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-06-25; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- The notifier is owned by team Boreal as of 2026-04-06, after the Cinder team handed it over. [decision; valid 2026-04-06 to now; recorded by handover/2026-04-06-notifier]
    earlier: The notifier is owned by team Cinder as of 2026-03-17. [valid 2026-03-17 to 2026-04-06; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-03-17]
- Reindex jobs will page on failure. [decision; valid 2025-10-27 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
